analysis.coverage: Full duration; all cuts at frame level.

concept.observed: An announcement told through one orange dot: it draws a question mark that tangles, becomes an i-dot, sits on blueprint guides, ends a list, then blooms into the closing title and draws its underline.
concept.interpreted: Personality traits (curious, rigorous, candid) presented as typographic vignettes linked by the dot.

communication_style.observed: Single words with small parenthetical asides; no narration.

palette.observed: Measured #1828a8 (47%) blue, #d8d8f8 (28%), white (12%); one orange accent.

typography.observed: Lowercase serif and grotesk words; a word extends with a suffix on construction lines; a serif word on white with an aside.

composition.observed: Centred single words; the dot keeps its screen position across cuts.

motion.observed: Dot draws lines, bounces onto staff lines, scrolls a vertical list with a focused item.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: Cuts at 2.00, 3.50, 5.00 and 7.82 s; static holds 0.06-1.06 s and 5.06-5.94 s.
timing_and_rhythm.interpreted: Even 1.5 s beats with breathing holds.

transitions.observed: Re-read 2026-11-27: 4 boundaries (3 cut, 1 grow, 0 cover, 0 continuous). 2.00 s cut: palette inversion (blue to pale) with a one-frame blend; the orange dot stays put and the scribble straightens into horizontal lines (2.01-2.17 s). 3.50 s cut: inversion back to blue with the dot held in place; a line draws from it. 5.00 s cut: hard cut to a white card with a serif word. 7.82 s grow: the line's full stop grows into a soft-edged blue disc that fills the frame in about 0.17 s (7.66-7.83 s); the dot stays as the next scene's anchor. Earlier reading (2026-10-30): Colour-inversion cuts with the dot held in place (2.00, 3.50 s); hard cut to white (5.00 s); full stop grows into a soft-edged circle that fills the frame (7.82 s).
transitions.interpreted: The held dot makes the inversion cuts read as one continuous object; the only grow is saved for the last turn.

audio_and_sync.observed: 1.9 onsets/s, tempo low confidence; boundaries not near onsets (0.0 vs 0.17 chance).
audio_and_sync.interpreted: Sparse audio, not cut to hits.

motifs.observed: The dot as i-dot, full stop, decimal point and pen.

sound_design.observed: Integrated -13.6 LUFS, LRA 2.4 LU, true peak -0.8 dBTP. 4 accents (24 a minute) at 3.55, 6.04, 6.55 and 8.06 s. Accents on cuts 0.25 against chance 0.08 (1 of 4); onsets near boundaries 0.00 against 0.17. A 0.9 s silence (5.13-6.04 s) ends on the accent at 6.04 s, when the first word of a stacked list takes its accent full stop; head -16.5 dB. Listen sheet: 3.55 s the dot returns and draws a line; 6.04 and 6.55 s list words take their full stops; 8.06 s the version numerals assemble around the dot.
sound_design.interpreted: A 0.9 s dropout before the list lands is the pre-hit dropout in a 10 s film; every accent sits on the dot or a full stop, the film's motif.

narration.observed: Dictation returned 3 words in 2 phrases (0.53-2.09 s, 8.12-9.31 s) over the dot drawing and the title card; no speaker on any phrase frame; 1-2 word 'phrases' are dictation noise over the music. Verdict: none.

captions.observed: None; copy is centred lowercase words, a right-aligned stacked list whose earlier lines dim as each new line takes the accent full stop (6.0-6.7 s), and a title with a small tagline. No caption lane.

scenes.observed: Blue: the dot draws a question mark that tangles into a scribble.
Light: staff-like lines; the dot lands as an i-dot in a word.
Blue: construction guides draw; a word extends.
White: a serif word with an aside, then a vertical list with a focused item.
Full stop blooms into blue; product title with the dot as decimal; underline drawn from the dot.

moments.observed: The list's full stop grows into the next scene.
moments.interpreted: Punctuation literally ends the sentence and opens the next idea.

uncertainties: Whether the scribble is drawn procedurally or hand-animated
